title: Tötungsdelikt zum Nachteil der 13-jährigen Lisa T. – Polizei sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen zu einem Fahrzeug

extraction.summaryEn: A 13-year-old girl who disappeared on her way to school in Marzahn was found dead in a vacant building in Altglietzen on 8 November. Police are seeking witnesses regarding a Citroën C5 estate suspected to have been used in the crime.
